newsitem.title: UK: Country Casuals tumbles on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Country Casuals tumbles on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Country Casuals Plc tumbled in early trading on Tuesday after the clothing retailer warned of a "significant deterioration" in trading since first-half results on October 9.
The stock was marked down 43-1/2p at 56-1/2 by 0859 GMT though no trading was recorded in the stock.

In a statement, the company said its Elvi unit had not been able to sustain first-half growth as it moved into the key autumn and winter season while its Lerose Manufacturing unit continued to report losses.
As a result, Country Casuals said it expected results for the year to January 1997 to be materially below current market forecasts and it did not expect to pay a dividend for the year.
